info.title: Battery sag and LED fade
info.question: Why does a weak battery dim an LED?
info.expected: Internal resistance sags under load; stored charge and open-circuit voltage fall as current is delivered.
info.try: Select B1 for live charge and voltage. Close S1 to add load. Change startup charge, capacity or ESR and Restart.
info.limitation: Linear charge reservoir: OCV=Vfull*q/Q; Q=3600*capacity_Ah; ESR voltage sag. Equivalent stored energy=Q*Vfull*SOC^2/2. No chemistry, temperature, ageing, self-discharge, protection or physical ratings. Positive delivered current discharges; externally forced charging is an ideal reversible reservoir, not a charger model. Startup SOC is 0..1; live SOC outside that range is reported, not hidden.
